strings.en: This pinball machine is a unique hybrid project that combines two different technologies: laser cutting/engraving and 3D printing, bringing to life a retro-style game inspired by the world of Pac-Man. The engravings include decorative writings such as PINBALL, RUN, and GAME OVER, as well as iconic shapes of Pac-Man and the ghosts, enriching the playfield with a nostalgic style.
